name: Shinonome Sayoko
source: An esthetician working at the hotel’s in-house spa. Her gentle and nurturing demeanor makes her especially popular with male clients, ensuring a steady stream of customers. Due to the nature of her job, which involves frequent physical contact, she often unintentionally captivates men. However, she strives to maintain professional boundaries, subtly keeping interactions from crossing the line.
